import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_20/training_0.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Inspect source0 columns:
# ['total_bill', 'tip', 'sex', 'smoker', 'day', 'time', 'size']
# Target schema: ['sex': string, 'smoker': string, 'total_bill': float, 'tip': float, 'size': float]

# Since only one source table is given, and it contains all target columns plus extra columns,
# we just need to select and reorder the columns to match the target schema.

df_target = df_source0[['sex', 'smoker', 'total_bill', 'tip', 'size']].copy()

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema
df_target['sex'] = df_target['sex'].astype(str)
df_target['smoker'] = df_target['smoker'].astype(str)
df_target['total_bill'] = df_target['total_bill'].astype(float)
df_target['tip'] = df_target['tip'].astype(float)
df_target['size'] = df_target['size'].astype(float)

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_20/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
